en.topic_title: Over 30% of sanitation workers not informed by employers about heat stress warnings, survey finds
en.topic_summary:
Over 30 per cent of sanitation workers are not being informed by employers when the Labour Department’s heat stress warnings are raised, a survey has found.



Cleaners in the New Territories. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP.



The Federation of Hong Kong and Kowloon Labour Unions (HKFLU) said at a press conference on Monday that it had surveyed 546 sanitation workers between May and July, local media reported.
